# omp-harness

Configures and operates the omp coding agent harness, covering global and project config layers, model roles and local-model routing, lsp.json language servers, TTSR rules, bash approval patterns, skills discovery, session storage and re-homing, RPC resumption and coordination between omp instances. Use when editing ~/.omp/agent/config.yml or a project .omp/config.yml, stopping a role from falling back to a hosted provider, fixing a language server that is not found, explaining why a new skill is missing, moving or resuming an omp session, or asking what the omp CLI can do. Do NOT use for writing AGENTS.md or setting up other coding agents such as Claude Code, Copilot or Codex (use ai-coding-agent-setup), or for general model selection with no omp configuration involved.

- **Entry point:** [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)
- **Version:** 1.0.0
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)

## Install

Copy this directory into either skills location, then start a new session:

```bash
cp -r omp-harness ~/.claude/skills/       # personal, all projects
cp -r omp-harness .claude/skills/         # this project only
```

For Claude Desktop, zip the directory and upload it under
Settings, Capabilities, Skills. Released builds attach a ready-made zip.

Loaded on demand, not up front. SKILL.md routes to them.
